scope: Create a hash-bound, model-only P8U Router50/F72-Base/Under-F120 final-refit package. No MC1, policy, portfolio, legacy live producer, exchange I/O, order submission, or live state is modified.
change: Historical P8U OOF score ledgers did not retain fold boosters. Regenerate the selected Router, Base, and Under contracts from their causal source panels at a declared 2026-08-28 UTC cutoff, serialize their model/preprocessing/reference state, and validate reload prediction parity on a target-free held sample.

training_contract.router: 30-field P8U RankXENDCG refit on 2026-04-30 through 2026-07-31 strict-resolved full-universe rows, 28-day reserve and 120000 complete-query cap; train empirical-CDF rank reference serialized.
training_contract.base: 72-field Raw-bps CatBoost QueryRMSE/tail_linear_125 refit on the same reserve window selected only by historical strict-OOF Router50 identities; train medians and selected 29-tree model serialized.
training_contract.under: 120-field RankXENDCG bps100 refit on 2026-03-31 through 2026-07-31 strict-resolved labels with four-month training and 28-day reserve. It uses the strict-OOF F72 Base ledger and prequential Base-to-policy anchors, never in-sample final Base scores. Nine Base geometry coordinates plus F120 medians are serialized.

validation.result: The package loaded all serialized models after individual SHA-256 verification. On a held target-free sample from 2026-07-30 to 2026-07-31, Router scored 3922 complete candidate identities, exact Router50 passed 1968 identities to Base and Under, and all raw/rank prediction deltas between in-memory and reloaded models were exactly zero. Seven focused P8U package and Router50 protection tests passed.

limitations: The discarded historical fold boosters cannot be byte-recovered; this receipt explicitly records a transparent final refit from their frozen selected contracts.
MC1, policy, portfolio, execution, and exchange authority remain outside this package and must be separately reconciled and sealed before any live promotion.
